summary: Short angled bays on a busy shopping strip with time limits.
reasons: Busy arterial at the Indooroopilly junction

drivers.seclusion: Retail frontage 7 m away, apartments 24 m, in the middle of a shopping strip.
drivers.access_and_room: Angle bays at the road edge are filled with cars; a van would overhang the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with turning lanes at a junction.
drivers.convention: Signed 10-minute and 2-hour angle parking, so no overnight use.

flags: Signs: 2P and P 10 Minute angle bays, peak-hour no stopping
sun_shade: Large tree shades the north end; otherwise open.
